Lower arch treatment only - very specific instructions below

1. Lower arch space closure to be carried out with controlled bodily retraction of the lower incisors
2. Using light continuous forces REDUCE THE VELOCITY OF EACH ALIGNER BY 30% 
3. Adequate torque control to ensure lingual root movement of LL1 and LR1, specifically to protect and avoid exacerbation of existing gingival recession
3. Avoid tipping mechanics, maintain alveolar housing, and closely monitor periodontal response throughout treatment.
